title: Co-Working Space Usage — IT Security Directive
content: Acme Corp IT Security Directive prohibits the use of public co-working spaces for work involving confidential client data. Employees working remotely from co-working spaces must connect exclusively via the company VPN at all times. Any employee found accessing company systems from a co-working space without VPN will have their remote access suspended immediately pending review. This directive applies to all employees and contractors. The definition of confidential data includes any client names, project specifications, financial data, or internal communications. Co-working space usage without VPN is a Category 2 security violation.
